authorization.requires: Fresh explicit owner authorization for the named arms, compute budget and synthetic-dataset generation before any run; the 2.00 CU V2 campaign ledger is not reused or reset.

arms.ZERO_SHOT_UNCONSTRAINED: Pinned SmolLM3, V3 prompt and native xml_tools, greedy generation under the profile decoding bounds. Measures syntax plus intent.
arms.ZERO_SHOT_CONSTRAINED: Pinned SmolLM3, same prompt, scripts/a02_v3_constrained.py grammar walk. Syntax control: removes format failure, isolates choice quality.
arms.ADAPTED_UNCONSTRAINED: Supervised-adapted candidate, native generation as in the first arm.
arms.ADAPTED_CONSTRAINED: Supervised-adapted candidate under the same grammar walk.
arms.STRONGER_MODEL_ZERO_SHOT: Optional; only if the rule escalates. Requires a separate preregistration naming the model.

adaptation.method: LoRA supervised fine-tuning on target_text tokens only (loss masked on prompt tokens); prompt rendered with the V3 action prompt and xml_tools exactly as at evaluation
adaptation.model_selection: No checkpoint selection on held-out data; the final checkpoint after the fixed schedule is evaluated once.

data.rights: Fully synthetic, generated by repository code; no external, empirical, RES-407 protected or RES-424 formal data.

heldout_evaluation.role: Sole decision input; never trained on or used for selection.

exposed_development_cases.role: DEVELOPMENT_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: reported per arm on every axis, including executor and final grounding; never training data, never held-out evidence, never a decision input.

metrics.primary: Exact V3 intent on the held-out set (strict parse and normalized equality with spec gold).
secondary: operation selection where gold names one
exposed_diagnostics_only: raw final grounding under the fixed rule

statistics.method: paired percentile bootstrap over held-out examples

compute_estimate.input_sources: Preflight (pinned tokenizer, V3 profile): max prompt 1,466 tokens, max gold-path cached fed tokens 1,890, max scorer calls 69, action cap 128. Session 004 T4 FP16: max steady first-token latency 0.41 s, min steady decode 23.05 tokens/s, 77.7 s pre-generation overhead plus a 35.6 s model load rounded to 113 s.
compute_estimate.consequence: Both zero-shot arms need about 39 minutes (2,361 s) of T4 time: more than one 900 s session, so any run needs a budget sized for it. Exposed-case diagnostics add 10 examples per arm. The adapted arms add training time, which is not estimated here because no training is authorized.
compute_estimate.scorer: Constrained arms use CachedSequenceLogprob with HFIncrementalBackend. Uncached full re-scoring would need up to 66,855 scored tokens per example instead of 1,890.

in_run_qualification: Before any arm result counts: score every option on the first 3 held-out examples with both the cached and the uncached reference binding; abort the run if any option differs by more than 1e-3 nats or the chosen action differs.
Verify the pinned model and tokenizer revisions and file hashes, and that rendered prompts reproduce the CPU preflight hashes.
Record raw generations, token ids and per-option scores for every example; score on CPU with scripts/a02_v3_score.py and scripts/a02_v3_decision.py only.
